title: Impressions Of The Shield Hero [Part 1]
paragraphs: “That’s how I returned to this world and, together with Father, defeated the crimson swine goddess. Father! How was it? My heroic figure?”
“…Do you think I would praise you for saying that?”
Seriously… every single day! Every time it’s dinner time, you start blabbering on and on!
Have you decided to become a bard or something? You begin telling the story of your incredibly long journey in the form of a tale every single night.
I don’t even remember when it started, but it’s been over a year, hasn’t it? Honestly, no joke, could you please stop already?

Rafatalia is silently glaring at Motoyasu with a menacing stare. Even I feel a little scared. However, I think Rafatalia has every right to do so. Ever since that incident, I’ve found myself agreeing with Motoyasu less and less. If something like this has happened, I can understand why. This has gone beyond simple annoyance; it’s a full-on mental attack.
“Oh! Spear bro, you’ve had quite the journey, huh!” Keel says excitedly, looking impressed, but does he even understand what he’s saying?

Whether there’s anything to praise about it is doubtful, and I really hope he realizes it might not even be true. I also sympathize with Rafatalia, who was so late in arriving because of reasons like this. Actually, I wonder just how much of it was a lie. I mean, he kept saying things like, “I knew this would happen in the village!” or giving after-the-fact explanations. By the way, Filo hasn’t heard this story from the start. She doesn’t go near Motoyasu. Whenever Motoyasu shows up, she either runs to Melty or hides somewhere, as usual.
“Hey, hey, Spear bro. Did you meet all the Philorials you mentioned in your story in this world?”
“Of course.”
Finally, at the end, Motoyasu answers Keel’s question. Before that, he kept dodging by saying things like, “It’s a secret!”
“First, there’s Yuki-chan.”

Motoyasu starts elaborating on what happened to the Philorials he often used during the loops. The Philorial named Yuki turned out to be the mother of the thoroughbred that Motoyasu had raised during the race when he and I raised Philorials together. After losing to the village’s Philorial, Yuki ended up joining with another Philorial that had become the queen under Motoyasu’s care and had a child. Motoyasu later realized this himself. So, the Philorial called Kou also hatched under Motoyasu’s command, and for some reason, it’s become quite close with the Raph species and they get along well.
Was Kou the father of the second hybrid between the Raph species and Philorial? Rato is currently researching that.
Was Sakura the one who turned into Filo?
“However, that Sakura person… tall, quiet, and someone who assists, how about exchanging Filo for her using divine power?”
Honestly, in terms of personality, it feels like she might be an upgrade over Filo.
Why should I have to deal with a bird that’s always so loud and assertive?
“With that logic, there’s also the suggestion of exchanging Lord Naofumi.”

Ugh… Rafatalia hits me right where it hurts. Thanks to Motoyasu, I end up looking like a good person and avoid being caught up in Vitch and the scum’s schemes. If I had to choose, I’d say the current me is probably better. …From a majority vote perspective, at least.
“Brother, you’re not that different, right?”
“Yeah. You’ve become more laid-back, and I don’t think there’s much of a difference.”
“What’s that supposed to mean, you guys!”
“Your words are rough, though.”
“Ahaha…”
I feel like I’m being completely looked down on here!
“Well… a lot of time has passed since that battle, and Lord Naofumi has become more mellow, I guess…”
“Hmph…”
Are you implying it was just a temporary change? Maybe it’s just that you’ve all gotten used to it?
“Lord Naofumi’s original kindness is unchanging!”
“Is it really, though?”
Atla also jumps in at this moment.
Is she trying to score points?
“However… I listened from start to finish, and it wasn’t interesting at all. I didn’t do anything useful, and there was no scenario where I could capture Lord Naofumi’s heart. So, I demand a retake.”
A retake is unnecessary. Atla closes her eyes, seemingly reprimanding Foul, but then she stares intently.
She can sense the surroundings even with her eyes closed, since she’s an elemental, right? Wasn’t she able to transcend that too?
“Atla?”
“This is all your fault, brother. If you hadn’t tried to get close to Lord Naofumi, I wouldn’t have ended up meeting him.”
“No, no! It’s not my fault… but… big bro…!”
“What are you stammering for!? And stop blushing, it’s disgusting!”
Foul still hasn’t quite learned, does he? He tends to get confused when thinking. Go back to training in the mountains.
“Atla, you’re still better off than most…”
“Lord Naofumi, that’s not the case.”
“…I’ll hear you out. What’s different?”
“My falling in love with Lord Naofumi is something that can only happen in this world.”
No… I didn’t think I was in love, though…
“Also, Rafatalia, depending on the situation, would betray Lord Naofumi. That’s the key point.”
“What nonsense are you spouting?!”

As expected, Rafatalia voiced her dissatisfaction with Atla’s words. As for betrayal, I think it’s more about a misunderstanding when I tried to report something, rather than actual betrayal. Besides, if we’re talking about betrayal, you’re basically the one taking care of a scum grandson.
“Yes… just because you happened to become friends with Lord Naofumi during the first time, don’t get too cocky.”
“Atla… what kind of person are you…”

Rafatalia was exasperated by Atla’s behavior. By the way, this isn’t exactly an unusual sight. We occasionally have these kinds of conversations, so we’re used to it by now. Well, during the loop, Motoyasu ignored Rafatalia to an unnatural extent.
How tough does Motoyasu think Rafatalia is? He must’ve heard the talk about illness and such.
“Anyway, this world is unique! It’s special. It’s best to just ignore the rumors and the like as nothing more than trivial gossip.”
“That’s quite a summary…”

I can’t believe you’d so easily dismiss such possibilities. From Rafatalia’s perspective, it was a matter of weighing her best friend and Naofumi. It’s not as simple as you make it sound. Alright, I’ll just brush off Atla’s story.
Hmm? Sadina was getting closer to Motoyasu.
Is she going to say something troublesome again?
“Sigh… Motoyasu, dear, could you tell me again about the part where Lord Naofumi and I get involved?”
“Understood!”
“What are you asking him for?!”
Sadina sometimes asks Motoyasu to retell the story of her interactions with me, showing a somewhat girlish expression while making her creepy requests. Seriously, stop it.
“Lord Naofumi…”
Sadina placed her right hand on my shoulder and rubbed her abdomen with her left hand.
“My tummy keeps saying it wants to bear Lord Naofumi’s child, it’s so exciting!”
“Don’t say creepy things!”
I slapped her hand off my shoulder and stepped back. …Lately, it feels like Sadina’s advances have been getting stronger. This is a dangerous trend.
“Aww, I’m so excited for the fun times with Lord Naofumi, I’m almost going crazy!”
“Don’t worry. Even as you are, you’re already crazy enough.”
“Well… it seems that, from what I’ve heard, Sadina-san often gets involved with the Shield Hero.”
Imia agreed, looking a bit embarrassed.
You don’t assert yourself much, but from Motoyasu’s stories, you were there, right? It seems you weren’t with Keel, though.
Hmm… as for Rafatalia and Atla… well, that’s fine. I’ll compromise, but Sadina… if I can promise something after Imia, I might be able to buy some time.
“Imia-chan, let’s also have some fun times with Lord Naofumi. Fall in love, big sister, time is precious. Come on, let’s go make Lord Naofumi fall for us together!”
“Eh, uh, that…”
…I feel like I’ve been preempted. Time to activate my crisis avoidance skills.
